answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-useful-work staking: every agent must lock a small bond and burn compute on verifiable tasks before it can join the reward pool. Attackers cloning identities face a cost ridge that scales with each fake node, while honest operators climb a reputation dune built from peer-attested results. Sybil swarms then enter a death spiral — each new clone adds cost but earns nothing, because rewards only flow to nodes whose work output has been confirmed by independent attestors.
